correctness.rationale: A fixed 12-by-12 icosahedral adjacency list yields exhaustive independent parity-propagation and odd-cycle-enumeration predicates over all 4096 subsets. The 1023-face vector and 32 minimal nonfaces agree. All twelve complement face pairs are individually verified as elementary collapses. One hundred size-six facets have 300 ridges, each with exactly two incident facets, and connected dual; a six-edge signed holonomy walk is -1, proving nonorientability. The explicitly generated 510-pair discrete Morse matching is acyclic by complete topological sort of 4212 Hasse incidences and leaves exactly critical degrees 0,4,5. The signed integer gradient recursion produces degree +2 from the critical 5-cell to the 4-cell, so the resulting CW model is M(Z/2,4). Independently computed mod-2 and mod-3 top boundary ranks (200,99) and (200,100) corroborate integral torsion. The verifier was executed from the actual embedded-file candidate path and returned VERIFY_OK. The domain is precisely one graph.

value.rationale: Odd-cycle-independent sets are a graph-theoretically motivated hereditary family from a verified archival source. For the canonical icosahedron, the exact integral homotopy type is an order-two Moore space, not a wedge of spheres; this detects torsion that rational homology entirely misses. The 100-facet pure five-pseudomanifold is nonorientable, and twelve explicit elementary collapses show that forbidding 5-cycles beyond triangles is topologically redundant here. These are structural graph-topology facts linking extremal vertex sets, simple homotopy, pseudomanifold orientation and integral torsion, not an arbitrary parameter slice or known-table recomputation.
